name: Manifests Unpredictable Abilities
description: Exposure to various anomalies has left you with fluctuating, unpredictable powers.
connectionOptions: One PC witnessed one of your anomalous manifestations.
You unknowingly affected one PC with your abilities in the past.
One PC is studying your condition, hoping to understand it.
You share a strange, possibly anomalous connection with one PC.

abilities.name: Unpredictable Talent
abilities.description: Once per day, gain training in a random skill for one hour.

abilities.name: Anomalous Resistance
abilities.description: You have +2 to Intellect defense rolls against anomalous mental effects.

abilities.name: Energy Surge
abilities.description: Once per day, you can release a surge of anomalous energy, affecting a random target within short range.

abilities.name: Probability Flux
abilities.description: You can spend 3 Intellect points to reroll any roll, but the GM decides if it's the higher or lower result.

abilities.name: Dimensional Shift
abilities.description: Once per day, you can attempt to briefly shift to a random dimension. This is a difficult Intellect task.

abilities.name: Anomalous Manifestation
abilities.description: You can attempt to manifest a random anomalous ability. Roll on a table provided by the GM to determine the effect.

abilities.name: Reality Breach
abilities.description: Once per session, you can open a temporary breach to another reality. The effects are unpredictable and determined by the GM.
